notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Discover Pirates: Rogue's Fortune!
notes.content:
Ahoy, future captains!
We’re thrilled to officially announce Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune and finally share with you a first glimpse of the adventure.

Our very first teaser is available now! Discover an action and adventure rogue-lite where every attempt brings you closer to becoming a legend: 

Explore the ocean depths in search of treasures ⚓ 

Face waves of fearsome enemies as you resurface ⚔

Upgrade your ship and arsenal to become the ultimate pirate ⛵


📺 Watch the teaser here:
[previewyoutube="gt5I0uad1yY;full"][/previewyoutube]
Pirates: Rogue’s Fortune will be available in Early Access in early 2026, and we can’t wait to sail with you to refine every detail thanks to your feedback.

At Ninpô, we’re a small independent team chasing a big dream, and your support means the world to us! Add the game to your wishlist and share it with your friends... It only takes a few seconds, but it helps us more than you can imagine. Thank you in advance!


💛 Add the game to your wishlist now: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2423280/"][/dynamiclink]

We’ll regularly share development updates, exclusive previews, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts. The adventure is just beginning!



— The NINPÔ Game Studio crew
